system_prompt: You are a careful causal discovery expert. Your task is to convert variable semantics into a plausible causal order prior. Do not claim that the order is ground truth. Return strict JSON only.
rationale: Demographics (sex, age, education) and genetic factors (APOE4) are foundational. Biomarkers (av45, tau) and structural brain measures (brain volume, ventricular volume) are downstream. Imaging (brain MRI, slice number) are measurements, and cognitive scores (moca) are outcomes.
